tasks.title: Confirm wirekit core exists on the base branch
tasks.description: Check for crates/wirekit/Cargo.toml with WirekitClient, WirekitError, retry, rate limit, tracing, and google_oauth. If absent, stop and report the feature as blocked on BP-005.

tasks.title: Confirm the XML and CSV dependency choices
tasks.description: Record quick-xml and csv with pinned versions and a confirmed MIT OR Apache-2.0 compatible licence before either is added.

tasks.title: Add the four module features to Cargo.toml
tasks.description: Add angi, google-lsa, sage-intacct, and adp as additive default-off features with optional dep: dependencies. Enabling one must not enable another.

tasks.title: Create and register the four module files
tasks.description: Add src/angi.rs, src/google_lsa.rs, src/sage_intacct.rs, and src/adp.rs behind cfg(feature), each opening with a //! comment stating scope and non-goals.

tasks.title: Document the features in the crate README
tasks.description: List each feature, what it adds, and whether it needs network access.

tasks.title: Define AngiLead and the dedupe key
tasks.description: Model the catalogue fields and implement a deterministic dedupe key: lead ID when present, otherwise normalized phone plus address plus date.

tasks.title: Define ParseError and its WirekitError conversion
tasks.description: ParseError exposes the offending field and reason, and converts into WirekitError through From without losing the field name.

tasks.title: Implement the email template parser
tasks.description: Parse the documented templates into AngiLead; return ParseError for an unknown template or a missing required field and never emit a partial lead.

tasks.title: Implement CSV import with per-row outcomes
tasks.description: AngiImport takes an explicit header mapping and yields one outcome per row with a 1-based row number; a missing column fails before any row is processed.

tasks.title: Implement optional partner webhook verification
tasks.description: Verify a shared-secret signature over the raw request bytes only, and return an explicit not-supported error when no partner feed is provisioned.

tasks.title: Confirm no HTTP client was added for Angi
tasks.description: The angi feature compiles alone and references no provider URL or HTTP client, because Angi has no public API.

tasks.title: Implement GoogleLsaClient construction
tasks.description: Take an account ID, a base URL, and an injected token source, and reuse wirekit::google_oauth for refresh (CON-212).

tasks.title: Define the LSA models
tasks.description: Type Lead, Booking, and LeadStatus from the catalogue fields; no raw JSON reaches the caller.

resolution.reason: The published localservices:v1 discovery document defines no lead-status or booking method

tasks.title: Implement list, get, update status, and report booking
tasks.description: Confirm provider paths from documentation before implementing, and return typed values from all four calls.

resolution.reason: The 403 account-not-approved branch belongs to the lead surface, which localservices:v1 does not publish.

tasks.title: Map the Google error envelope and the 403 case
tasks.description: Map into WirekitError::Api and surface HTTP 403 as the explicit account-not-linked-or-unapproved variant with a redacted body.

resolution.reason: No LSA endpoint remains to exercise the per-provider rate-limit bucket; the wirekit core retry and rate-limit policy is already tested.

tasks.title: Wire retry and the per-provider rate-limit bucket
tasks.description: Use the core retry policy (three attempts, 5xx/429/network, Retry-After honoured) and a per-provider token bucket with tracing on a hit.

tasks.title: Make status updates idempotent and notifications explicit
tasks.description: A replayed status update produces no second mutation, and a missing Pub/Sub or webhook configuration returns a not-configured error.

tasks.title: Implement SageIntacctClient and its configuration
tasks.description: Sender ID, company ID, endpoint, and a password held in the wirekit secret type, redacted in Debug and never Serialize.

tasks.title: Define the Intacct request models
tasks.description: Customer, Invoice, JournalEntry, and ReportRequest, limited to create or update customer, create invoice, create journal entry, read by key, and report invocation.

resolution.reason: Intacct shipped a documented generic call() instead of named Customer/Invoice/JournalEntry models

tasks.title: Parse the gateway result instead of the HTTP status
tasks.description: Derive success from status and errno; HTTP 200 with a failure status returns an error carrying both values.

tasks.title: Enforce XML input bounds
tasks.description: Configuration-driven byte ceiling and nesting depth; exceeding either returns a typed bound error with no partial model.

tasks.title: Make creates idempotent by external key
tasks.description: Query before create and return the existing record when the external key is already present.

tasks.title: Classify business errors as non-retryable
tasks.description: A business-rule error is not resent unchanged, emits no retry event, and polling or reconciliation is documented as the caller's responsibility.

resolution.reason: ADP partner access was never granted and developers.adp.com publishes no machine-readable API contract, so no route could be verified

tasks.title: Implement AdpClient with a cached client-credentials token
tasks.description: Cache the token until expiry and refresh it exactly once after a 401 before failing the call.

tasks.title: Return an unknown outcome for a payroll timeout

tasks.title: Report batch outcomes per record
tasks.description: A partial export lists failed records by identifier and reports the successes, so no hour is dropped silently.

tasks.title: Keep tenant state on the client instance
tasks.description: No module-level cache, static, or singleton; two clients for two tenants share no credential, token, or response.

tasks.title: Trace requests without leaking values
tasks.description: Emit request start, finish with duration, retry, rate-limit hit, and error; record no secret or personal field.

resolution.reason: Descoped to a follow-up release; behaviour and API surface are unaffected

tasks.title: Take every credential from the caller
tasks.description: No key, token, password, or company ID is embedded, defaulted, or logged, and nothing is read from a .env file (CON-519, CON-706).

tasks.title: Enforce HTTPS and the sandbox override
tasks.description: Every live module accepts a base URL, defaults to the documented production URL, and rejects a non-HTTPS override at construction.

tasks.title: Remove panics from untrusted input paths
tasks.description: Email, CSV, JSON, XML, and ADP error payloads each produce a typed error; no unwrap, expect, or slice indexing on parsed data.

tasks.title: Document each module's public surface
tasks.description: Every public item has rustdoc and each module has a runnable documentation example.

tasks.title: Run the formatter check
tasks.description: cargo fmt --all --check passes.

tasks.title: Run the linter
tasks.description: cargo clippy -p wirekit --all-features -- -D warnings passes.

tasks.title: Build the documentation
tasks.description: cargo doc -p wirekit --all-features --no-deps passes with RUSTDOCFLAGS set to -D warnings.

tasks.title: Compile every feature combination
tasks.description: no-default-features plus one feature per module all compile on Rust 1.85, and enabling one module never enables another.

tasks.description: node .sdrive/scripts/validate-governance.js reports every artifact valid.
